# getTools

abstract suspend fun [getTools](get-tools.html)(readonlyContext: [ReadonlyContext](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-readonly-context/index.html)? = null): [List](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-list/index.html)<[BaseTool](../-base-tool/index.html)>

Return all tools in the toolset based on the provided context.

#### Return

A list of tools available under the specified context.

#### Parameters

 _readonly Context_

Context used to filter tools available to the agent. Defaults to `null`, meaning no filtering context is supplied and all tools in the toolset are returned. Toolsets that do not filter by context may ignore this parameter.
